armA.definition: Correct in all details; exact and free from error.
armA.arabic: دقيق ومظبوط جدًا، مفيهوش أي غلطة.
examples: The clock is accurate.
Is this information accurate?
Please give an accurate description.
The figures are not completely accurate.
Accurate forecasting is essential for business.
Historians strive for an accurate account of events.
armA.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'A cure' 'علاج'.. الدكتور الشاطر لازم تشخيصه يكون 'Accurate' عشان يديك الـ 'Cure' الصح.

armB.definition: Correct in all details; exact and free from error.
armB.arabic: دقيق ومظبوط جدًا، مفيهوش أي غلطة.
examples: Is this information accurate?
Please give an accurate description.
The figures are not completely accurate.
armB.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'A cure' 'علاج'.. الدكتور الشاطر لازم تشخيصه يكون 'Accurate' عشان يديك الـ 'Cure' الصح.

armA.definition: To manage and organize the affairs of a company or to give a treatment to a patient.
armA.arabic: يدير أو يعطي. ممكن تيجي بمعنى يدير شغل أو منظمة، وممكن تيجي بمعنى يعطي دواء لمريض.
examples: He administers the group.
The doctor administers the medicine.
She helps to administer the school's daily operations.
The fund is administered by a professional bank.
The nurse was trained to administer first aid in emergencies.
The court has the authority to administer justice in this region.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Admin'.. الـ 'Admin' هو اللي بيعمل 'Administer' 'بيدير' الجروب أو الشغل.

armB.definition: To manage and organize the affairs of a business or institution, or to officially give or apply something such as medicine or justice.
armB.arabic: يدير أو يُشرف على عمل أو مؤسسة، أو يعطي علاجاً/دواءً لمريض، أو يطبّق وينفّذ إجراءً رسمياً مثل تطبيق العدالة.
examples: She helps to administer the school's daily operations.
The nurse was trained to administer first aid in emergencies.
The court has the authority to administer justice in this region.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Admin'.. الـ 'Admin' هو اللي بيعمل 'Administer' 'بيدير' الجروب أو الشغل.

armA.definition: A chief bishop responsible for an archdiocese.
armA.arabic: رتبة دينية كبيرة في المسيحية، بيكون رئيس الأساقفة.
examples: He was appointed as the new archbishop.
The archbishop delivered a sermon on peace.
Ecclesiastical laws are interpreted by the archbishop.
armA.mnemonic: 'Arch' يعني رئيسي 'زي Arch-enemy' + 'Bishop' أسقف.. يبقى 'رئيس الأساقفة'.

armB.definition: A chief bishop responsible for an archdiocese.
armB.arabic: رتبة دينية كبيرة في المسيحية، بيكون رئيس الأساقفة.
examples: The archbishop prayed.
We saw the archbishop at the church.
The Archbishop of Canterbury is a famous figure.
He was appointed as the new archbishop.
The archbishop delivered a sermon on peace.
Ecclesiastical laws are interpreted by the archbishop.
armB.mnemonic: 'Arch' يعني رئيسي 'زي Arch-enemy' + 'Bishop' أسقف.. يبقى 'رئيس الأساقفة'.

armA.definition: Able to express thoughts and feelings clearly and effectively.
armA.arabic: شخص فصيح، بيعرف يعبر عن أفكاره بوضوح ولباقة.
examples: She is very articulate for her age.
He is an intelligent and articulate speaker.
The teacher gave an articulate explanation.
armA.mnemonic: زي 'Article' 'مقال'.. الشخص الـ 'Articulate' بيتكلم بوضوح وترتيب كأنه بيقرا 'Article' مكتوب ببراعة.

armB.definition: Able to express thoughts and feelings clearly and effectively.
armB.arabic: شخص فصيح، بيعرف يعبر عن أفكاره بوضوح ولباقة.
examples: He speaks clearly.
She is very articulate for her age.
The teacher gave an articulate explanation.
He is an intelligent and articulate speaker.
She was unusually articulate about her feelings.
The lawyer presented a highly articulate defense of his client.
armB.mnemonic: زي 'Article' 'مقال'.. الشخص الـ 'Articulate' بيتكلم بوضوح وترتيب كأنه بيقرا 'Article' مكتوب ببراعة.

armA.definition: Except; apart from.
armA.arabic: بتيجي بمعنى 'إلا' أو 'باستثناء'. زي لما تقول 'كلهم مشيوا ما عدا هو'.
examples: Everyone but Tom was there.
I have nothing left but hope.
There is no one here but me.
The last but one.
Anything but that.
They had no alternative but to surrender.

armB.definition: Except; apart from.
armB.arabic: بتيجي بمعنى 'إلا' أو 'باستثناء'. زي لما تقول 'كلهم مشيوا ما عدا هو'.
examples: Everyone but Tom was there.
There is no one here but me.
They had no alternative but to surrender.

armA.definition: To contact someone by phone or shout to them.
armA.arabic: يتصل بحد في التليفون أو ينادي عليه بصوت عالي. وممكن تيجي بمعنى يسمي.
examples: Please call me tomorrow.
They call him 'Big Joe'.
I will call a taxi for you.

armB.definition: To contact someone by phone or shout to them.
armB.arabic: يتصل بحد في التليفون أو ينادي عليه بصوت عالي. وممكن تيجي بمعنى يسمي.
examples: Please call me tomorrow.
They call him 'Big Joe'.
I will call a taxi for you.
The meeting was called to order.
I call into question his honesty.
The situation calls for immediate action.

armA.definition: To be able to or permitted to do something.
armA.arabic: بمعنى 'يقدر' أو 'يستطيع' عمل شيء، أو يُستخدم لطلب الإذن.
examples: I can swim.
Can you help me?
You can park here.

armB.definition: To be able to or permitted to do something.
armB.arabic: بمعنى 'يقدر' أو 'يستطيع' يعمل حاجة.
examples: I can swim.
Can you help me?
You can park here.
Can it be true?
I can't help thinking about it.
One can hardly imagine the difficulty.

armA.definition: To talk in a friendly and informal way.
armA.arabic: يدردش أو يتكلم مع حد بشكل ودي وبسيط.
examples: I like to chat with my friends online.
She likes to chat on the phone.
They often sit in the café and chat for hours.
armA.mnemonic: نفس كلمة 'شات'.. بتعمل شات مع صاحبك.

armB.definition: To talk in a friendly and informal way.
armB.arabic: يدردش أو يتكلم مع حد بشكل ودي وبسيط.
examples: I chat with my friends.
She likes to chat on the phone.
We chatted for hours about nothing.
He was chatting up a girl at the bar.
They chatted amiably despite their differences.
We chatted away the afternoon in the garden.
armB.mnemonic: نفس كلمة 'شات'.. بتعمل شات مع صاحبك.

armA.definition: The protruding part of the face below the mouth.
armA.arabic: منطقة الدقن اللي في وشك تحت بوقك.
examples: He has a small chin.
She rested her chin on her hand.
He rubbed the stubble on his chin.
Keep your chin up, things will get better.
The boxer took a heavy blow to the chin.
He has a prominent, cleft chin.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Chin' قريبة من 'Cheek'.. الاتنين في الوش.

armB.definition: The protruding part of the face below the mouth.
armB.arabic: منطقة الدقن اللي في وشك تحت بوقك.
examples: She rested her chin on her hand.
He rubbed the stubble on his chin.
The boxer took a heavy blow to the chin.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Chin' قريبة من 'Cheek'.. الاتنين في الوش.

armA.definition: To cut something into pieces with a sharp tool like a knife or axe.
armA.arabic: يقطع أو يفرم. تقطع حاجة حتت صغيرة بالسكينة أو الفاس.
examples: Please chop the onions into small pieces.
Use a sharp axe to chop wood for the fire.
They plan to chop down the old tree in the garden.
armA.mnemonic: تخيل الشيف بيعمل 'Chop chop' بسرعة وهو بيقطع الخضار

armB.definition: To cut something into pieces with a sharp tool like a knife or axe.
armB.arabic: يقطع أو يفرم. تقطع حاجة حتت صغيرة بالسكينة أو الفاس.
examples: Please chop the onions.
He chopped wood for the fire.
Chop the carrots into small cubes.
They chopped down the old tree in the garden.
The budget was chopped by fifty percent.
The helicopter blades chopped through the heavy air.
armB.mnemonic: تخيل الشيف بيعمل 'Chop chop' بسرعة وهو بيقطع الخضار

armA.definition: The property possessed by an object of producing different sensations on the eye as a result of the way it reflects light.
armA.arabic: اللون، زي الأحمر والأزرق، اللي بنشوفه بعيننا لما الضوء ينعكس على الأشياء.
examples: The sky is a beautiful blue colour.
She added some colour to the drawing.
The leaves change colour in autumn.

armB.definition: The property possessed by an object of producing different sensations on the eye as a result of the way it reflects light.
armB.arabic: اللون، زي الأحمر والأزرق، اللي بنشوفه بعيننا لما الضوء ينعكس على الأشياء.
examples: What is your favorite colour?
The sky is a beautiful blue colour.
She added some colour to the drawing.
The leaves change colour in autumn.
The festival was a riot of colour and sound.
His writing lacks colour and imagination.

armA.definition: In a way that is true or accurate.
armA.arabic: إنك تعمل الحاجة صح من غير غلطات.
examples: Spell your name correctly.
He answered correctly.
If I remember correctly, he was there.
The machine was not operating correctly.
She correctly predicted the outcome of the election.
The data must be interpreted correctly to be useful.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Correct' 'صح'.. يعني عملتها بشكل 'Correct'.

armB.definition: In a way that is true or accurate.
armB.arabic: إنك تعمل الحاجة صح من غير غلطات.
examples: Spell your name correctly.
He answered correctly.
If I remember correctly, he was there.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Correct' 'صح'.. يعني عملتها بشكل 'Correct'.

armA.definition: An agreement entered into by two or more parties for their mutual benefit.
armA.arabic: اتفاق أو صفقة بين طرفين، زي لما تتفق مع حد على بيع وشراء.
examples: It is a good deal.
We made a deal with the supplier.
The government signed a trade deal with China.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Deal' يعني اتفاق.. لما تخلص كلام مع حد تقول 'It's a Deal' يعني اتفقنا خلاص.

armB.definition: An agreement entered into by two or more parties for their mutual benefit.
armB.arabic: اتفاق أو صفقة بين طرفين، زي لما تتفق مع حد على بيع وشراء.
examples: It is a good deal.
We made a deal with the supplier.
I have a great deal of work to do today.
The government signed a trade deal with China.
He got a raw deal from the insurance company.
The peace deal was brokered under difficult circumstances.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Deal' يعني اتفاق.. لما تخلص كلام مع حد تقول 'It's a Deal' يعني اتفقنا خلاص.

armA.definition: To take action to solve a problem (deal with) or to distribute cards in a game.
armA.arabic: إنك تتعامل مع مشكلة أو شخص، أو توزع الكوتشينة في اللعب.
examples: I have to deal with this problem immediately.
We only deal with reputable companies.
Whose turn is it to deal the cards?
armA.mnemonic: لما تقول 'Deal with it' يعني 'اتعامل' مع الموضوع وحله.

armB.definition: To take action to solve a problem (deal with) or to distribute cards in a game.
armB.arabic: إنك تتعامل مع مشكلة أو شخص، أو توزع الكوتشينة في اللعب.
examples: I deal the cards now.
I have to deal with this problem immediately.
The book deals with the history of Egypt.
We only deal with reputable companies.
She is used to dealing with difficult customers.
The sanctions were designed to deal a blow to the regime.
armB.mnemonic: لما تقول 'Deal with it' يعني 'اتعامل' مع الموضوع وحله.

armA.definition: Relying on someone or something else for support or survival.
armA.arabic: معتمد على حد أو حاجة تانية، مش مستقل بنفسه.
examples: Babies are dependent on their mothers.
He is dependent on his parents for money.
Your grade is dependent on your final exam.
The country is heavily dependent on oil exports.
Drug dependent patients need special care.
The variables are mutually dependent in this equation.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Depend' 'يعتمد'.. الـ 'Dependent' هو الشخص اللي بيعمل 'Depend' على غيره.

armB.definition: Relying on someone or something else for support or survival.
armB.arabic: معتمد على حد أو حاجة تانية، مش مستقل بنفسه.
examples: Babies are dependent on their mothers.
The country is heavily dependent on oil exports.
Your grade is dependent on your final exam.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Depend' 'يعتمد'.. الـ 'Dependent' هو الشخص اللي بيعمل 'Depend' على غيره.

armA.definition: A highly intelligent sea animal that looks like a large fish with a beak-like snout.
armA.arabic: حيوان بحري ذكي جداً وصديق للإنسان، بيحب يلعب ونشوفه في العروض.
examples: The dolphin swims fast.
I saw a dolphin in the sea.
A dolphin jumped out of the water next to our boat.
armA.mnemonic: نفس النطق بالعربي 'دُلفين'.. ممكن تربطها بـ 'Doll' 'لعبة' لأنه بيحب يلعب.

armB.definition: A highly intelligent sea animal that looks like a large fish with a beak-like snout.
armB.arabic: حيوان بحري ذكي جداً وصديق للإنسان، بيحب يلعب ونشوفه في العروض.
examples: The dolphin swims fast.
I saw a dolphin in the sea.
Dolphins are known for their intelligence.
We went on a boat trip to watch the dolphins.
The dolphin's sonar capabilities are fascinating to scientists.
Conservationists are worried about the declining dolphin population.
armB.mnemonic: نفس النطق بالعربي 'دُلفين'.. ممكن تربطها بـ 'Doll' 'لعبة' لأنه بيحب يلعب.

armA.definition: A thing or person that is the same as another; twice the quantity.
armA.arabic: حاجة أو شخص شبه التاني بالظبط، أو كمية مضاعفة.
examples: Give me a double.
He is the double of his father.
Make that a double, please.
She acted as a double for the actress.
His body double did the dangerous stunts.
To pay double is unfair.

armB.definition: Twice the amount, size, or number of something.
armB.arabic: ضِعف الشيء، أي مقداره أو كميته مرتين.
examples: She earns double what I do for the same work.
To pay double for the same ticket is completely unfair.
We cooked enough food for ten guests, which was double what we needed.

armA.definition: To or in the main business or commercial area of a town or city.
armA.arabic: في أو إلى وسط البلد، أي في أو نحو المنطقة التجارية والمركزية للمدينة.
examples: She lives downtown.
He works downtown but lives in the suburbs.
We drove downtown to see the parade.
armA.translations: في وسط البلد إلى وسط البلد
armA.mnemonic: لما تقول 'I am going downtown' كأنك بتقول أنا نازل 'Down' لقلب الـ 'Town'.

armB.definition: To or in the main business or commercial area of a town or city.
armB.arabic: ناحية وسط البلد، لما تكون رايح للمنطقة التجارية.
examples: Let's go downtown.
She lives downtown.
We drove downtown to see the parade.
He works downtown but lives in the suburbs.
They ventured downtown to explore the nightlife.
The protest marched downtown, gathering momentum along the way.
armB.mnemonic: لما تقول 'I am going downtown' كأنك بتقول أنا نازل 'Down' لقلب الـ 'Town'.

armA.definition: To prepare a preliminary version of a text; or to recruit someone for military service.
armA.arabic: يكتب مسودة أو يجهز خطة مبدئية، أو يجند حد في الجيش.
examples: The legal team will draft a new contract tomorrow.
You should draft a preliminary outline before writing the final essay.
The military may draft eligible citizens during a national crisis.
armA.mnemonic: نفس فكرة الاسم.. بيعمل 'Draft' يعني بيجهز ويخطط.

armB.definition: To prepare a preliminary version of a text; or to recruit someone for military service.
armB.arabic: يكتب مسودة أو يجهز خطة مبدئية، أو يجند حد في الجيش.
examples: Draft a letter.
We drafted a plan for the party.
She was drafted into the team.
Lawyers drafted the new contract.
He was drafted into the army at age 18.
The committee drafted a resolution to address the crisis.
armB.mnemonic: نفس فكرة الاسم.. بيعمل 'Draft' يعني بيجهز ويخطط.

armA.definition: To make something free from water or liquid.
armA.arabic: إنك تنشف حاجة وتشيل منها المية.
examples: You can dry your hands on the towel.
The sun will dry the clothes.
I need to dry my hair.
armA.mnemonic: اربط الفعل بأجهزة شائعة مثل hairdryer (مجفف الشعر)؛ فالفعل dry يعني يجفف أو ينشف.

armB.definition: To make something free from water or liquid.
armB.arabic: إنك تنشف حاجة وتشيل منها المية.
examples: Dry your hands on the towel.
The sun will dry the clothes.
I need to dry my hair.
The wood needs time to dry out.
The tears dried on her cheeks.
The soil has dried up completely due to the drought.
armB.mnemonic: نفس الاسم، 'Dry' يعني ينشف.

armA.definition: The joint between the forearm and the upper arm.
armA.arabic: الكوع، المفصل اللي بيربط بين دراعك من فوق ومن تحت.
examples: My elbow hurts.
He rested his elbows on the table.
She nudged him with her elbow.
The room was so crowded we were standing elbow to elbow.
He used some elbow grease to clean the floor.
She accidentally banged her funny bone, which is actually the nerve in the elbow.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Elbow' .. شكل الكوع عامل زي حرف 'L' .. 'L-bow'.

armB.definition: The joint between the forearm and the upper arm.
armB.arabic: الكوع، المفصل اللي بيربط بين دراعك من فوق ومن تحت.
examples: My elbow hurts.
She nudged him with her elbow.
He rested his elbow on the table.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Elbow' .. شكل الكوع عامل زي حرف 'L' .. 'L-bow'.

armA.definition: An unborn offspring in the process of development; an early stage of something.
armA.arabic: الجنين في مراحله الأولى قبل اكتمال تكوينه، أو مرحلة البداية والتطور المبكر لأي مشروع أو فكرة.
examples: The doctor checked the health of the embryo.
Human embryo research is a controversial topic.
The idea of democracy was present in embryo in ancient Greece.

armB.definition: An unborn offspring in the process of development; an early stage of something.
armB.arabic: الجنين في مراحله الأولى خالص قبل ما يتكون شكله الكامل، أو بداية أي فكرة.
examples: The egg has an embryo.
We studied the chicken embryo.
The doctor checked the health of the embryo.
The project is still in embryo.
Human embryo research is a controversial topic.
The idea of democracy was present in embryo in ancient Greece.

armA.definition: A thing characteristic of its kind or illustrating a general rule.
armA.arabic: مثال.. نموذج بيوضحلك الفكرة عشان تفهمها أحسن.
examples: This is a good example.
Can you give me an example?
For example, you can eat fruit.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Exam' 'امتحان' جزء منها.. والامتحان عبارة عن 'Examples' 'أمثلة' بنحلها.

armB.definition: A thing characteristic of its kind or illustrating a general rule.
armB.arabic: مثال.. نموذج بيوضحلك الفكرة عشان تفهمها أحسن.
examples: This is a good example.
Can you give me an example?
For example, you can eat fruit.
She sets a good example for her sister.
This case is a classic example of the problem.
He was punished to make an example of him.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Exam' 'امتحان' جزء منها.. والامتحان عبارة عن 'Examples' 'أمثلة' بنحلها.

armA.definition: Birds that are kept on a farm for their eggs or meat (like chickens), or wild birds hunted for food.
armA.arabic: الطيور اللي بتتربى في المزارع للأكل زي الفراخ والبط (الدواجن)، أو الطيور البرية التي تُصاد للأكل.
examples: Chickens are a type of fowl.
They sell fish, meat, and fowl at the market.
The hunter returned with a brace of wild fowl.
armA.mnemonic: نفس نطق كلمة 'Foul' (فاول في الكورة) بس المعنى مختلف.. هنا معناها طيور أو دواجن.

armB.definition: Birds that are kept on a farm for their eggs or meat (like chickens).
armB.arabic: الطيور اللي بتتربى في المزارع للأكل زي الفراخ والبط 'الدواجن'.
examples: We keep fowl on the farm.
Chickens are a type of fowl.
They sell fish, meat, and fowl at the market.
The disease affected the local water fowl.
The hunter returned with a brace of wild fowl.
Guinea fowl are considered a delicacy in some cuisines.
armB.mnemonic: نفس نطق كلمة 'Foul' 'فاول في الكورة' بس المعنى مختلف.. هنا معناها طيور.

armA.definition: Having an empty space inside; not solid.
armA.arabic: مجوَّف.. يعني فاضي من جوا مش مصمت، زي الماسورة أو جذع شجرة فاضي
examples: The ball is hollow inside.
Owls often live in hollow trees.
It was a hollow victory because nobody celebrated.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Hollow' أولها 'Hole'.. يعني جواها خرم أو فراغ كبير

armB.definition: Having an empty space inside; not solid.
armB.arabic: مجوَّف.. يعني فاضي من جوا مش مصمت، زي الماسورة أو جذع شجرة فاضي
examples: The ball is hollow inside.
Owls often live in hollow trees.
His voice sounded hollow in the empty room.
It was a hollow victory because nobody celebrated.
She felt a hollow emptiness in her chest after he left.
The politician's promises turned out to be hollow.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Hollow' أولها 'Hole'.. يعني جواها خرم أو فراغ كبير

armA.definition: Originating or occurring naturally in a particular place; native.
armA.arabic: أصلي أو بلدي؛ تُقال لوصف النباتات أو الحيوانات أو السكان الذين نشأوا وعاشوا في منطقة معينة بشكل طبيعي.
examples: This plant is indigenous to Mexico.
The kangaroo is indigenous to Australia.
Globalization poses a threat to many indigenous languages and traditions.
armA.mnemonic: أولها 'Indi'.. فكر في 'Indian' 'الهنود الحمر' هما الـ 'Indigenous' 'السكان الأصليين' لأمريكا.

armB.definition: Originating or occurring naturally in a particular place; native.
armB.arabic: أصلي أو بلدي. بتتقال على السكان الأصليين لبلد، أو النباتات والحيوانات اللي نشأت في مكان معين طبيعياً.
examples: Indigenous people live here.
This plant is indigenous to Mexico.
We learned about the indigenous culture.
The government protected the rights of indigenous tribes.
The kangaroo is indigenous to Australia.
Globalization poses a threat to many indigenous languages and traditions.
armB.mnemonic: أولها 'Indi'.. فكر في 'Indian' 'الهنود الحمر' هما الـ 'Indigenous' 'السكان الأصليين' لأمريكا.

armA.definition: A member of the people and cultural community whose traditional religion is Judaism.
armA.arabic: شخص بيتبع الديانة اليهودية أو بينتمي للشعب اليهودي.
examples: He is a Jew.
Jews celebrate Hanukkah.
She learned about the history of the Jews.
The museum honors Jews who fought in the war.
Orthodox Jews follow strict dietary laws.
The diaspora of the Jews is a major historical subject.

armB.definition: A member of the people and cultural community whose traditional religion is Judaism.
armB.arabic: شخص بيتبع الديانة اليهودية أو بينتمي للشعب اليهودي.
examples: He was raised as a Jew and continues to observe traditional holidays.
As a practicing Jew, David observes the Sabbath every Saturday.
A secular Jew may celebrate cultural traditions without being strictly religious.

armA.definition: A printed sheet of paper containing information or advertising, usually distributed for free.
armA.arabic: ورقة مطبوعة صغيرة بتتوزع في الشارع أو بتيجي مع الدواء فيها معلومات أو إعلانات.
examples: The leaflet explains how to use the device.
Check the side effects in the patient information leaflet.
We designed a promotional leaflet for the campaign.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Leaf' يعني ورقة شجر.. والـ 'Leaflet' ورقة صغيرة زي ورقة الشجر.

armB.definition: A printed sheet of paper containing information or advertising, usually distributed for free.
armB.arabic: ورقة مطبوعة صغيرة بتتوزع في الشارع أو بتيجي مع الدواء فيها معلومات أو إعلانات.
examples: Read the leaflet.
They handed out a leaflet.
The leaflet explains how to use the device.
Check the side effects in the patient information leaflet.
We designed a promotional leaflet for the campaign.
Dropping leaflets from the air was a common propaganda tactic.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Leaf' يعني ورقة شجر.. والـ 'Leaflet' ورقة صغيرة زي ورقة الشجر.

armA.definition: Relating to the Middle Ages (roughly 500–1500 AD).
armA.arabic: حاجة ليها علاقة بالعصور الوسطى، زمن القلاع والفرسان.
examples: We visited a medieval town in France.
The museum has a collection of medieval art.
The legal system was described as positively medieval.
armA.translations: من العصور الوسطى قروسطي خاص بالقرون الوسطى
armA.mnemonic: فيها 'Mid' يعني وسط.. 'Medieval' يعني العصور الوسطى.

armB.definition: Relating to the Middle Ages (roughly 500–1500 AD).
armB.arabic: حاجة ليها علاقة بالعصور الوسطى، زمن القلاع والفرسان.
examples: An old castle.
Knights lived in medieval times.
We visited a medieval town in France.
The museum has a collection of medieval art.
The legal system was described as positively medieval.
Medieval philosophy attempted to reconcile faith with reason.
armB.mnemonic: فيها 'Mid' يعني وسط.. 'Medieval' يعني العصور الوسطى.

armA.definition: Used to emphasize that you mean exactly what you are saying and nothing more.
armA.arabic: يعني 'فقط' أو 'بس'.. بتستخدمها لما تحب تقلل من حجم أو أهمية حاجة.
examples: I am merely trying to help.
We are merely suggesting a different approach.
He said nothing, merely smiled and walked away.
armA.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Mirror' 'مراية'.. هي 'Merely' 'مجرد' انعكاس

armB.definition: Used to emphasize that you mean exactly what you are saying and nothing more.
armB.arabic: يعني 'فقط' أو 'بس'.. بتستخدمها لما تحب تقلل من حجم أو أهمية حاجة.
examples: It is merely a cat.
I am merely trying to help.
The movie is merely okay, not great.
We are merely suggesting a different approach.
He said nothing, merely smiled and walked away.
The philosopher argued that life is merely a series of sensory experiences.
armB.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Mirror' 'مراية'.. هي 'Merely' 'مجرد' انعكاس

armA.definition: A large amount of (used before uncountable nouns).
armA.arabic: كتير.. بتيجي قبل الاسم عشان توصف كميته.
examples: How much water?
I don't have much hope.
There isn't much difference.
He caused much trouble.
With much regret, I decline.
After much consideration, we agreed.

armB.definition: A large amount of (used before uncountable nouns).
armB.arabic: كتير.. بتيجي قبل الاسم عشان توصف كميته.
examples: I don't have much hope.
There isn't much difference.
He caused much trouble.

armA.definition: Soft, wet earth.
armA.arabic: التراب لما يختلط بالمية ويبقى طين أو وحل.
examples: The car got stuck in the mud.
My shoes are covered in mud.
Pigs like to roll in the mud.

armB.definition: Soft, wet earth.
armB.arabic: التراب لما يختلط بالمية ويبقى طين أو وحل.
examples: My shoes are covered in mud.
Pigs like to roll in the mud.
The car got stuck in the mud.
Heavy rain turned the field into a sea of mud.
His name is mud around here after what he did.
The political campaign descended into mere mud-slinging.

armA.definition: Frequently; many times; on many occasions.
armA.arabic: غالباً، أو في أوقات كثيرة وبشكل متكرر (كتير، وعكسها نادراً).
examples: I often go to the park.
How often do you brush your teeth?
He often works late at night.
armA.translations: غالباً كثيراً في كثير من الأحيان
armA.mnemonic: شبه 'Off' و 'On'.. النور بيقطع عندنا 'Often' كتير

armB.definition: Frequently; many times; on many occasions.
armB.arabic: كتير، أو في أوقات كتير. عكسها نادراً.
examples: I often go to the park.
How often do you brush your teeth?
We visit them as often as possible.
He often works late at night.
Old houses often need repairs.
It is often said that time heals all wounds.
armB.mnemonic: شبه 'Off' و 'On'.. النور بيقطع عندنا 'Often' كتير

armA.definition: The act of allowing someone to do something.
armA.arabic: الإذن أو السماح.. لما تطلب من حد يوافق إنك تعمل حاجة
examples: You need permission to park here.
She gave me permission to use her car.
He entered the building without permission.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Permit' يسمح.. أو افتكر إن أي 'Mission' 'مهمة' محتاجة 'Permission' 'إذن' عشان تبدأ

armB.definition: The act of allowing someone to do something.
armB.arabic: الإذن أو السماح.. لما تطلب من حد يوافق إنك تعمل حاجة
examples: Can I have permission to leave?
You need permission to park here.
She gave me permission to use her car.
He entered the building without permission.
Planning permission was granted for the new extension.
The usage of copyright material requires explicit written permission.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Permit' يسمح.. أو افتكر إن أي 'Mission' 'مهمة' محتاجة 'Permission' 'إذن' عشان تبدأ

armA.definition: A structure leading out from the shore into a body of water, used as a landing stage.
armA.arabic: رصيف خشبي أو حجري ممدود جوه البحر عشان الناس تمشي عليه أو المراكب تقف عنده.
examples: People were fishing off the end of the pier.
The storm damaged the wooden pier.
The pier features an amusement park and restaurants.
armA.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Peer' 'يبحلق'.. بنقف على الـ 'Pier' ونبص على البحر.

armB.definition: A structure leading out from the shore into a body of water, used as a landing stage.
armB.arabic: رصيف خشبي أو حجري ممدود جوه البحر عشان الناس تمشي عليه أو المراكب تقف عنده.
examples: We walked on the pier.
The boat is at the pier.
People were fishing off the end of the pier.
The storm damaged the wooden pier.
The pier features an amusement park and restaurants.
The bridge is supported by concrete piers sunk into the riverbed.
armB.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Peer' 'يبحلق'.. بنقف على الـ 'Pier' ونبص على البحر.

armA.definition: With the addition of; together with.
armA.arabic: بنستخدمها لما نكون بنضيف حاجة لحاجة تانية، بمعنى 'زائد' أو 'وكمان'.
examples: One plus one equals two.
The cost is $10 plus tax.
I have three meetings plus a lunch appointment.
The hotel offers breakfast plus free Wi-Fi.
Intelligence plus ambition is a powerful combination.
The salary includes a base rate plus a commission on sales.

armB.definition: With the addition of; together with.
armB.arabic: تُستخدم عند إضافة شيء إلى شيء آخر، بمعنى 'زائد' أو 'بالإضافة إلى'.
examples: One plus one equals two.
The cost is $10 plus tax.
I have three meetings plus a lunch appointment.

armA.definition: Of great value; not to be wasted or treated carelessly.
armA.arabic: غالي جداً وثمين، سواء بقيمته المادية أو العاطفية.
examples: Gold is a precious metal.
My family is precious to me.
Don't waste precious time.
armA.mnemonic: زي 'Price' (سعر).. الشيء الـ 'Precious' هو اللي الـ 'Price' وقيمته عالية جداً.

armB.definition: Of great value; not to be wasted or treated carelessly.
armB.arabic: غالي جداً وثمين، سواء فلوس أو قيمة عاطفية.
examples: Gold is a precious metal.
My family is precious to me.
Don't waste precious time.
She keeps her precious memories in a box.
Water is a precious resource in the desert.
He was accused of being precious about his art.
armB.mnemonic: زي 'Price' 'سعر'.. الـ 'Precious' هو اللي الـ 'Price' بتاعه عالي جداً.

armA.definition: Coming before a more important action or event; preparatory.
armA.arabic: حاجة تمهيدية أو مبدئية بتتعمل قبل الحدث الأساسي أو المهم.
examples: The preliminary findings suggest a significant correlation.
The team passed the preliminary round with ease.
After a preliminary investigation, the committee approved the proposal.
armA.mnemonic: فيها 'Pre' يعني قبل.. 'Preliminary' يعني التحضير اللي قبل البداية.

armB.definition: Coming before a more important action or event; preparatory.
armB.arabic: حاجة تمهيدية أو مبدئية بتتعمل قبل الحدث الأساسي أو المهم.
examples: This is just the start.
We did a quick check first.
These are preliminary results.
The team passed the preliminary round.
Preliminary discussions were held yesterday.
The preliminary findings suggest a significant correlation.
armB.mnemonic: فيها 'Pre' يعني قبل.. 'Preliminary' يعني التحضير اللي قبل البداية.

armA.definition: Truly what something is said or regarded to be; genuine or appropriate.
armA.arabic: مناسب أو صحيح.. الحاجة المضبوطة اللي المفروض تتعمل بالشكل الصح.
examples: This is the proper way.
Please put it in the proper place.
You need the proper tools for the job.
It is not proper to speak like that to your boss.
Without proper authorization, you cannot enter.
Technically, the suburbs are not part of the city proper.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Proper' قريبة من 'Prop' 'دعامة'.. الدعامة لازم تكون 'Proper' 'سليمة' عشان تشيل المبنى

armB.definition: Correct, suitable, or acceptable according to an agreed or socially approved standard.
armB.arabic: مناسب أو صحيح.. الحاجة المضبوطة اللي المفروض تتعمل بالشكل الصح.
examples: Please put it in the proper place.
You need the proper tools for the job.
It is not proper to speak like that to your boss.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Proper' قريبة من 'Prop' 'دعامة'.. الدعامة لازم تكون 'Proper' 'سليمة' عشان تشيل المبنى

armA.definition: Energy that moves in waves or particles, like heat, light, or nuclear energy.
armA.arabic: الإشعاع. طاقة بتتحرك في الجو، ممكن تكون مفيدة زي أشعة الشمس، أو خطيرة زي الإشعاع النووي.
examples: The sun gives off radiation.
Too much radiation is bad for you.
Radiation therapy is used to treat cancer.
They measured the levels of radiation in the area.
The ozone layer protects us from ultraviolet radiation.
Cosmic radiation poses a significant risk to astronauts on long missions.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Radio'.. الراديو بيشتغل عن طريق موجات الـ 'Radiation' 'الإشعاع الكهرومغناطيسي'.

armB.definition: Energy that moves in waves or particles, like heat, light, or nuclear energy.
armB.arabic: الإشعاع. طاقة بتتحرك في الجو، ممكن تكون مفيدة زي أشعة الشمس، أو خطيرة زي الإشعاع النووي.
examples: The sun gives off radiation.
They measured the levels of radiation in the area.
The ozone layer protects us from ultraviolet radiation.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Radio'.. الراديو بيشتغل عن طريق موجات الـ 'Radiation' 'الإشعاع الكهرومغناطيسي'.

armA.definition: To build something again after it has been damaged or destroyed.
armA.arabic: إنك تبني حاجة تاني من الأول بعد ما اتكسرت أو اتهدمت، سواء بيت أو حتى حياتك.
examples: They rebuild the house.
We must rebuild the wall.
The city had to rebuild after the fire.
It takes time to rebuild trust in a relationship.
The government promised to rebuild the shattered economy.
They sought to rebuild the philosophical foundations of the movement.
armA.mnemonic: المقطع 'Re' يعني تاني، و 'Build' يعني يبني.. يبقى المعنى يبني تاني.

armB.definition: To build something again after it has been damaged or destroyed.
armB.arabic: إنك تبني حاجة تاني من الأول بعد ما اتكسرت أو اتهدمت، سواء بيت أو حتى حياتك.
examples: The city had to rebuild after the fire.
It takes time to rebuild trust in a relationship.
The government promised to rebuild the shattered economy.
armB.translations: يعيد بناء يُعيد إعمار إعادة بناء
armB.mnemonic: المقطع 'Re' يعني تاني، و 'Build' يعني يبني.. يبقى المعنى يبني تاني.

armA.definition: To rule as a monarch, or to prevail and predominate in a particular place or situation.
armA.arabic: يحكم كملك أو ملكة، أو يسود ويعم في مكان أو موقف معين (مثل سيادة الفوضى أو الهدوء).
examples: The monarch is expected to reign for many years to come.
If the peace talks fail, complete chaos will reign across the region.
Few tennis players could hope to reign supreme over their rivals for so long.

armB.definition: To rule as a king or queen; to be the best or most important.
armB.arabic: يحكم ويسيطر كملك، أو لما حاجة معينة هي اللي تسود وتنتشر.
examples: The King reigns.
She reigned for 50 years.
Chaos reigned in the streets.
He reigns supreme in the boxing world.
Silence reigned after the announcement.
The champion still reigns over the division.

armA.definition: In an unwilling and hesitant way.
armA.arabic: لما تعمل حاجة وإنت مش عايز تعملها، بتعملها بتقل وبدون نفس.
examples: I reluctantly agreed to help him.
They reluctantly accepted the offer.
The government reluctantly admitted its mistake.
armA.mnemonic: 'Reluctant' قريبة من 'Lock'.. كأنك 'Locked' ومجبر تعمل الحاجة فبتعملها 'Reluctantly'.

armB.definition: In an unwilling and hesitant way.
armB.arabic: لما تعمل حاجة وإنت مش عايز تعملها، بتعملها بتقل وبدون نفس.
examples: He went reluctantly.
She reluctantly said yes.
I reluctantly agreed to help him.
They reluctantly accepted the offer.
The government reluctantly admitted its mistake.
He reluctantly relinquished control of the company he founded.
armB.mnemonic: 'Reluctant' قريبة من 'Lock'.. كأنك 'Locked' ومجبر تعمل الحاجة فبتعملها 'Reluctantly'.

armA.definition: To keep someone or something under control or prevent them from doing something.
armA.arabic: إنك تمنع حد أو حاجة من الحركة، أو تسيطر على تصرفاتهم بالقوة.
examples: Please restrain your dog.
He couldn't restrain his anger.
Police had to restrain the crowd.
You must restrain the child in a car seat.
She tried to restrain her disappointment.
The government took measures to restrain inflation.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Strain' يعني شد.. لما تعمل 'Restrain' لحد، إنت بتشده لورا وتمنعه.

armB.definition: To keep someone or something under control or prevent them from doing something.
armB.arabic: إنك تمنع حد أو حاجة من الحركة، أو تسيطر على تصرفاتهم بالقوة.
examples: Police had to restrain the crowd.
He couldn't restrain his anger.
The government took measures to restrain inflation.
armB.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Strain' يعني شد.. لما تعمل 'Restrain' لحد، إنت بتشده لورا وتمنعه.

armA.definition: To echo or resound repeatedly, or to have continuing and widespread effects.
armA.arabic: الصوت لما يتردد ويعمل صدى قوي، أو خبر ينتشر ويعمل ضجة.
examples: The loud organ music began to reverberate through the grand hall.
Her unexpected resignation will reverberate across the political landscape.
The economic crash will reverberate for decades to come.
armA.translations: يتردد صداه يدوي يترك أثراً واسعاً
armA.mnemonic: فيها جزء 'Vibrate' 'يهتز'.. الصوت لما يـ 'Reverberate' بيعمل اهتزاز وصدى في المكان.

armB.definition: To echo or resound repeatedly.
armB.arabic: الصوت لما يتردد ويعمل صدى قوي، أو خبر ينتشر ويعمل ضجة.
examples: The sound hit the wall.
The loud noise made the room shake.
The drum beat reverberated through the hall.
Her voice reverberated around the empty church.
The scandal reverberated through the political world.
The economic crash will reverberate for decades to come.
armB.mnemonic: فيها جزء 'Vibrate' 'يهتز'.. الصوت لما يـ 'Reverberate' بيعمل اهتزاز وصدى في المكان.

armA.definition: In a circle or curve; around.
armA.arabic: بشكل دائري، أو في كل مكان.
examples: Turn round.
Pass the papers round.
He looked round the room.
There is enough food to go round.
The wheels went round and round.
She won him round to her point of view.
armA.mnemonic: نفس الرابط.

armB.definition: In a circle or curve, or so as to face in the opposite direction; around.
armB.arabic: بشكل دائري، أو في الاتجاه المعاكس (لوراء)، أو في كل مكان.
examples: Turn round so I can see your face.
Pass the papers round to everyone in the room.
There is enough food to go round.
armB.translations: حول للخلف في دائرة على الجميع

armA.definition: Relating to or characteristic of the countryside rather than the town.
armA.arabic: ريفي.. أي حاجة ليها علاقة بالريف والزراعة، عكس المدن.
examples: She lives in a rural area.
Rural life is very quiet.
We drove through the rural countryside.
The government is investing in rural development.
Rural depopulation is a major issue in this region.
The dichotomy between rural and urban values is stark.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Rural' فيها صوت 'Roar'.. زي أصوات الحيوانات في الريف.

armB.definition: Relating to or characteristic of the countryside rather than the town.
armB.arabic: ريفي.. أي حاجة ليها علاقة بالريف والزراعة، عكس المدن.
examples: She lives in a peaceful rural area.
Public transport is often limited in rural communities.
The government is investing in rural development.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Rural' فيها صوت 'Roar'.. زي أصوات الحيوانات في الريف.

armA.definition: From a past time until now, or used to show the reason for something.
armA.arabic: كلمة بنستخدمها عشان نقول إن حاجة بدأت من وقت معين في الماضي ومستمرة، أو عشان نقول السبب 'بمعنى عشان أو بما إن'.
examples: I have been here since Monday.
She hasn't eaten since breakfast.
Since you are here, please help me.
He has improved a lot since he joined the team.
It has long since been forgotten by the public.
Since the premise is flawed, the conclusion must be rejected.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Sense'.. لما يكون عندك 'Sense' بالوقت، هتعرف إن الموضوع بدأ 'Since' فترة.

armB.definition: From a past time until now, or used to show the reason for something.
armB.arabic: كلمة بنستخدمها عشان نقول إن حاجة بدأت من وقت معين في الماضي ومستمرة، أو عشان نقول السبب 'بمعنى عشان أو بما إن'.
examples: Since you are here, please help me.
He has improved a lot since he joined the team.
We stayed inside since it was raining.
armB.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Sense'.. لما يكون عندك 'Sense' بالوقت، هتعرف إن الموضوع بدأ 'Since' فترة.

armA.definition: In the period after a specified time in the past.
armA.arabic: من وقت معين في الماضي ومستمر لحد دلوقتي.
examples: I have been here since Monday.
She has known him since childhood.
It has been raining since this morning.

armB.definition: In the period after a specified time in the past.
armB.arabic: من وقت معين في الماضي ومستمر لحد دلوقتي.
examples: I have been here since Monday.
She has known him since childhood.
It has been raining since this morning.
Since the war began, many have fled.
Since the dawn of time, humans have looked at the stars.
The regulations have changed since the last audit.

armA.definition: Beautiful, dramatic, and eye-catching; extremely impressive to see or experience.
armA.arabic: حاجة مبهرة جداً وشكلها يجنن، تخطف العين من جمالها أو روعتها.
examples: The mountain range offers spectacular scenery for hikers.
She looked spectacular in that dress.
The team suffered a spectacular failure.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Spectacles' 'نظارة'.. حاجة محتاجة تلبس 'Spectacles' عشان تشوف حلاوتها كويس.

armB.definition: Beautiful in a dramatic and eye-catching way.
armB.arabic: حاجة مبهرة جداً وشكلها يجنن، تخطف العين من جمالها.
examples: The view is spectacular.
We saw a spectacular show.
The fireworks were spectacular.
She looked spectacular in that dress.
The team suffered a spectacular failure.
The mountain range offers spectacular scenery for hikers.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Spectacles' 'نظارة'.. حاجة محتاجة تلبس 'Spectacles' عشان تشوف حلاوتها كويس.

armA.definition: A form of words used as a magical charm; OR a short period of time.
armA.arabic: ليها معنيين: تعويذة سحرية زي اللي في القصص، أو فترة زمنية قصيرة 'زي موجة حر'.
examples: The witch cast a spell.
We had a spell of hot weather.
He rested for a short spell.
She fell under his spell.
The dry spell damaged the crops.
The wizard recited an ancient spell to unlock the door.
armA.mnemonic: الساحرة بتعمل 'Spell' 'تعويذة' عشان تسحرك.. وممكن تقول 'Cold spell' يعني موجة برد.

armB.definition: A form of words used as a magical charm; OR a short period of time.
armB.arabic: ليها معنيين: تعويذة سحرية زي اللي في القصص، أو فترة زمنية قصيرة 'زي موجة حر'.
examples: The dry spell damaged the crops across the entire region.
After working for hours, he paused to rest for a short spell.
According to legend, the witch cast a powerful spell over the kingdom.
armB.mnemonic: الساحرة بتعمل 'Spell' 'تعويذة' عشان تسحرك.. وممكن تقول 'Cold spell' يعني موجة برد.

armA.definition: To write or name the letters that form a word in the correct sequence.
armA.arabic: يتهجى، يعني يقول حروف الكلمة بالترتيب الصح.
examples: Can you spell your name?
How do you spell 'cat'?
I can't spell very well.
Please spell out the details.
The new policy spells disaster for small businesses.
His silence spelled the end of their relationship.
armA.mnemonic: أكيد عارف الـ 'Spelling'.. الفعل 'Spell' يعني يتهجى الكلمة.

armB.definition: To write or name the letters that form a word in the correct sequence.
armB.arabic: يتهجى، يعني يقول حروف الكلمة بالترتيب الصح.
examples: Can you spell your name?
How do you spell 'cat'?
I can't spell very well.
armB.mnemonic: أكيد عارف الـ 'Spelling'.. الفعل 'Spell' يعني يتهجى الكلمة.

armA.definition: To learn about a subject, usually at school or university.
armA.arabic: تخصص وقت ومجهود عشان تتعلم حاجة أو تفهم موضوع، زي المذاكرة.
examples: I study English every day.
We study together in the library after school.
You need to study hard to pass the test.

armB.definition: To learn about a subject, usually at school or university.
armB.arabic: تخصص وقت ومجهود عشان تتعلم حاجة أو تفهم موضوع، زي المذاكرة.
examples: I study English every day.
She is studying to be a doctor.
He studied the map carefully.
Scientists are studying the effects of the virus.
We need to study the proposal in detail.
He studied his opponent's face for any sign of weakness.

armA.definition: Used to identify a specific person or thing close at hand.
armA.arabic: أداة تحديد بتيجي قبل الاسم عشان توضح إننا بنتكلم عن 'هذا' الشيء القريب.
examples: I like this car.
This week has been busy.
We need to solve this problem.

armB.definition: Used to identify a specific person or thing close at hand.
armB.arabic: أداة تحديد بتيجي قبل الاسم عشان توضح إننا بنتكلم عن 'هذا' الشيء القريب.
examples: I like this car.
This week has been busy.
We need to solve this problem.
In this country, people drive on the left.
At this point in time, we cannot comment.
Under this particular interpretation, the law is invalid.

armA.definition: A powerful motor vehicle with large rear wheels, used chiefly on farms for hauling equipment.
armA.arabic: جرار زراعي قوي بيمشي في الأرض الطينة عشان يحرثها أو يشد حاجات تقيلة.
examples: The farmer drives a tractor.
A red tractor is in the field.
He used a tractor to pull the heavy trailer.
Modern tractors are equipped with GPS technology.
The agricultural sector relies heavily on tractor maintenance.
The mechanization of farming began with the introduction of the steam tractor.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Traction' يعني جرّ.. الـ 'Tractor' هو اللي بيعمل الجرّ ده في المزرعة.

armB.definition: A powerful motor vehicle with large rear wheels, used chiefly on farms for hauling equipment.
armB.arabic: جرار زراعي قوي بيمشي في الأرض الطينة عشان يحرثها أو يشد حاجات تقيلة.
examples: The farmer drives a tractor.
A red tractor is in the field.
He used a tractor to pull the heavy trailer.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Traction' يعني جرّ.. الـ 'Tractor' هو اللي بيعمل الجرّ ده في المزرعة.

armA.definition: To come or bring together for a common purpose or action.
armA.arabic: يعني يتحدوا أو يتجمعوا عشان هدف واحد. زي لما الناس تتحد عشان تعمل تغيير أو الدول تتحد في حلف.
examples: We must unite now.
The team united to win the game.
Music can unite people from different cultures.
The two companies decided to unite to increase profits.
The tragedy served to unite the community in grief.
Various factions attempted to unite under a single banner of revolution.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Unit' يعني وحدة.. لما الناس تعمل 'Unite' بيتحولوا لـ 'Unit' 'وحدة' واحدة قوية.

armB.definition: To come or bring together for a common purpose or action.
armB.arabic: يعني يتحدوا أو يتجمعوا عشان هدف واحد. زي لما الناس تتحد عشان تعمل تغيير أو الدول تتحد في حلف.
examples: Music can unite people from different cultures.
The two companies decided to unite to increase profits.

armA.definition: Complete; absolute.
armA.arabic: يعني كامل أو مُطلق، زي لما تقول 'فوضى عارمة' أو 'ظلام دامس'.
examples: It was utter silence.
The room was in utter darkness.
That is utter nonsense.
The party was an utter failure.
He looked at me in utter amazement.
The situation descended into utter chaos after the announcement.
armA.mnemonic: شبه 'Outer'.. حاجة واصلة للحد الأقصى 'Utter'.

armB.definition: Complete; absolute.
armB.arabic: يعني كامل أو مُطلق، زي لما تقول 'فوضى عارمة' أو 'ظلام دامس'.
examples: The situation descended into utter chaos after the announcement.
He looked at me in utter amazement.
That explanation turned out to be utter nonsense.
armB.mnemonic: شبه 'Outer'.. حاجة واصلة للحد الأقصى 'Utter'.

armA.definition: Through a place on the way to another destination, or by means of a particular system, method, or medium.
armA.arabic: عبر أو بالمرور بمكان ما في الطريق إلى وجهة أخرى، أو بواسطة وسيلة أو طريقة معينة.
examples: We are flying to Tokyo via Dubai.
He sent the message via email.
The news was broadcast via satellite to millions.

armB.definition: Traveling through a place on the way to a destination, or by means of.
armB.arabic: إنك تروح مكان عن طريق مكان تاني، أو تعمل حاجة بواسطة أداة معينة.
examples: I went home via the park.
He sent the message via email.
We are flying to Tokyo via Dubai.
The news was broadcast via satellite to millions.
She achieved success via a highly unconventional route.
The disease is transmitted via respiratory droplets in the air.

armA.definition: To measure how heavy someone or something is.
armA.arabic: توزن حاجة عشان تعرف هي كام كيلو، أو تفكر في قرار وتقارن بين الاختيارات.
examples: I weigh 70 kilos.
Please weigh the fruit.
He weighed himself on the scales.
You need to weigh the pros and cons.
The evidence weighed heavily against him.
She had to weigh her words carefully before speaking.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Way' 'طريق'.. وانت في الـ 'Way' للمطار لازم تعمل 'Weigh' 'وزن' للشنط بتاعتك.

armB.definition: To measure how heavy someone or something is, or to consider something carefully before making a choice.
armB.arabic: توزن حاجة عشان تعرف هي كام كيلو، أو تفكر في قرار وتقارن بين الاختيارات.
examples: Please weigh the fruit.
You need to weigh the pros and cons.
She had to weigh her words carefully before speaking.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Way' 'طريق'.. وانت في الـ 'Way' للمطار لازم تعمل 'Weigh' 'وزن' للشنط بتاعتك.

armA.definition: But; nevertheless; despite that.
armA.arabic: بتيجي بمعنى 'لكن' أو 'مع ذلك' عشان تربط جملتين فيهم تناقض.
examples: It is small yet strong.
The path was dark, yet I found my way.
He has a good job, and yet he never seems to have any money.

armB.definition: But; nevertheless; despite that.
armB.arabic: بتيجي بمعنى 'لكن' أو 'مع ذلك' عشان تربط جملتين فيهم تناقض.
examples: It is small yet strong.
He is old, yet he runs fast.
The path was dark, yet I found my way.
It was a strange yet beautiful song.
He has a good job, and yet he never seems to have any money.
Simple yet profound, the theory explains everything.
